source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.4 with Figs. 6.6 and 6.7 and Example 6.2 (PDF 126-128).

blocks.text: Jab system ko heat di jaye to us ki internal energy barhti hai: temperature barhta hai, pressure barhta hai ya halat (state) badalti hai. Agar usi waqt cheez ko phail kar surroundings (aas paas ki cheezein) par work karne diya jaye, to zaroori heat Q do kaam karti hai: internal energy ko pehli halat ki U₁ se doosri halat ki U₂ tak le jati hai, aur surroundings par work W bhi karti hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar qataren, har ek mein System ka dabba. 1: Heat, positive ka teer system mein: +Q. 2: Heat, negative ka teer system se bahar: -Q. 3: Work, negative ka teer system mein: -W. 4: Work, positive ka teer system se bahar: +W.
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 126): Heat aur work ke sign conventions (nishan lagane ke qaide) (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: system ko jo heat mile woh positive (+Q), jo heat system de woh negative (−Q). Work ulta hai: system jo work kare (bahar jata teer) woh positive (+W), system par jo work ho (andar aata teer) woh negative (−W). Isi se Q = ΔU + W banta hai.

Is tarah internal energy ki change (badlao) ΔU = U₂ − U₁ ko Q − W kaha jata hai. Yeh har us process ke liye ek hi hai jo do halaton ke darmiyan ho, is liye thermodynamics ka pehla law yun likha jata hai:

blocks.title: Thermodynamics ka pehla law
blocks.text: Kisi bhi thermodynamic process mein jab system ko heat Q di jaye, to yeh energy do jagah jati hai: system ki internal energy ka increase (barhna) ΔU, aur system ka apne surroundings par kiya hua work W.

items: Conservation ka principle (qaida): pehle law ki basis (jar) energy ka conservation (bachao, yani energy na banti hai na mitti) hai. Energy ek shakal se doosri mein badal sakti hai (jaise chemical potential energy se thermal energy), magar isolated system (jo bahar se kuch na le na de) mein kul energy hamesha utni hi rehti hai.

Har jagah lagu: yeh law sirf mechanical systems par nahi, energy ki har shakal aur har process par lagu hai, jaise chemical reactions, electrical systems aur nuclear reactions. Is se scientists aur engineers energy ki changes ko samajh aur pehle se bata sakte hain.

blocks.text: Pehla law energy ke conservation ka law hi hai: isolated system mein energy kam ya zyada nahi hoti. Yeh samjhata hai ke system ke andar energy kaise ek jagah se doosri jagah jati aur shakal badalti hai, aur yeh principle kabhi nahi tootta ke energy na banai ja sakti hai na khatam ki ja sakti hai. Isi liye universe (saari duniya aur aasman) mein energy ka behaviour (kaam karne ka tareeqa) samajhne ke liye pehla law bohat aham hai.

Cycle ka pump achhi misal hai. Jab hum handle tezi se chalate hain to pump garam ho jata hai, kyun ke gas par mechanical work hota hai aur us ki internal energy barhti hai. Aisa saada intezam Fig. 6.6 mein hai: cycle ka pump jis ka mooh (outlet) band hai. Band mooh mein laga thermocouple hawa ka temperature dikhata hai. Piston tezi se dhakelne par thermometer temperature barhta dikhata hai, kyun ke hawa ki internal energy barh gayi. Dhakelne wali force hawa par work karti hai, is se hawa ki internal energy barhti hai, jo temperature barhne se nazar aati hai.

blocks.alt: Lakri ke takhte par rakha cycle ka pump. Barrel mein band hawa par Trapped air in pump likha hai; daen taraf handle par Piston pushed in ka teer hai. Baen taraf band outlet par thermocouple ek Millivoltmeter se tar ke zariye jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.6: Band outlet wala cycle pump, thermocouple aur millivoltmeter (kitab ki Figure 6.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Piston tezi se andar dhakelne par band hawa par work hota hai; heat ko bahar nikalne ka waqt nahi milta, is liye hawa ki internal energy aur temperature barhte hain. Thermocouple yeh garmi naap kar millivoltmeter ki sui hila deta hai.

Insaan ka metabolism bhi energy conservation ki misal hai. Insaan aur janwar chalne, daurne ya hilne mein work karte hain, aur work ke liye energy chahiye. Barhne, naye cells banane aur mar chuke purane cells ki jagah naye lane ke liye bhi energy chahiye. Body (jism) ke andar energy badalne wale saare processes metabolism kehlate hain. Pehla law (ΔU = Q − W) insaani body par lagayein: body jo work karti hai us se us ki internal energy kam hoti hai. Is liye body ka temperature, yani internal energy, hamare food (khurak) se qaim rehti hai.

blocks.title: Example 6.2
blocks.problem: Ek bartan mein gas band hai jis par 0.10 m² cross-sectional area ka piston laga hai. Gas ka pressure 8000 N m⁻² par qaim rakha jata hai. Aahista heat dene par piston 4.0 cm oopar jata hai. Phailne ke dauran system ko 42 J heat di jaye to internal energy mein kitni change hogi?
steps: Gas ka kiya hua work: W = PΔV = PAΔy
Pehle law se: ΔU = Q − W = 42 J − 32 J = 10 J
blocks.answer: Internal energy 10 J barh jati hai: 42 J heat mein se 32 J work ban gaye aur 10 J gas ke andar reh gaye.
